title: How to choose between AI market research companies: 15 vendors reviewed
summary: Compare 15 AI market research companies, from platforms your team runs to agencies adding AI, and learn how to pilot your shortlist.
body_markdown:
What are the top AI market research companies? +


The top AI market research companies fall into four groups. Conveo, Listen Labs, Outset, and Strella sell AI qualitative research tools that your own team runs. GetWhy, Discuss, and Qualtrics add optional research services from their own staff. Glaut and Tellet sell mainly to market research agencies. Ipsos and Kantar are agencies that have built their own AI tools. Teams that run research every month usually start with a platform, and teams that need in-person fieldwork usually start with an agency.


What is the difference between an AI market research platform and a market research agency? +


A market research agency sells research services. Its researchers design the study, recruit participants, run fieldwork, and hand over the findings. An AI market research platform is research software your own team uses to run studies, with artificial intelligence running the interviews and using natural language processing to code transcripts into themes. With an agency, you’re paying for human expertise on one project. With a platform, you’re paying for tools your research team can use on every project, and the results build up in one place.


Can AI market research platforms replace an agency? +


Sometimes, but many teams use both. The best AI qualitative research companies handle recurring questions well, such as concept tests and message checks, because the team can run them as often as needed. Some can also run research continuously, so the team sees how consumer views shift from one wave to the next. Agencies still suit rare, high-stakes projects that need specialist fieldwork or senior human expertise, such as a market entry study behind major strategic decisions. A common split is to run routine qualitative research in-house on a platform and keep agency budget for the projects that need it most.


Are AI-moderated interviews as reliable as human-moderated ones? +


According to leading AI qualitative research providers, they can be. In AI-moderated research, the core questions stay consistent across interviews while follow-up questions adapt to each answer, which makes results easier to compare, and interviews can run in multiple languages at once. However, moderation quality still varies by vendor, so check how well follow-up questions dig into vague answers. Recordings and quotes let you check each interview yourself so you can ensure it’s accurate.


How do AI market research companies analyze qualitative data? +


Many use natural language processing to transcribe interviews and code participant responses into themes. Some also read tone of voice and facial expression from video recordings. Qualitative analysis quality varies by vendor, so check whether each theme links back to the quotes or clips behind it, and whether researchers can correct the coding manually. Automated thematic analysis speeds up interview analysis, and a researcher should still review the themes before they inform a decision.


How are AI market research companies priced? +


Pricing follows the business model. Agencies usually charge per project. Platforms usually charge a subscription or sell credits that teams spend on each study. Few vendors publish prices, so most quotes come through sales. The biggest cost drivers are the number of interviews and the audience, since hard-to-reach groups cost more per participant. Ask whether panel recruitment is included or billed separately, because it can change the total considerably.
